title: Everything from the stage died
intro: When everything fails at once, look for the one thing everything shares.

complaints.says: Every mic and every wedge just went silent at the same moment!

hints: Every channel goes through the stagebox to the mixer. What connects those two?
cause: The network cable between the stagebox and the mixer had come unplugged at the stagebox.
lesson: All 16 inputs and all 8 wedge outputs ride on one network cable. If everything dies at once, check the stagebox's Network light and that cable first.
